mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) compresses equity discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and compresses valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is below 2.0% and unemployment rate is below 4.0%, the combination signals strong monetary accommodation and labor market tightness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 17000 billion and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, the economy is in a late-cycle expansion phase, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained growth momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 17000 and HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (above 4.5%) indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic stagnation.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105 and federal funds rate is below 2.0%, the economy experiences strong supply growth under accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in robust economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250, the economy is in a high-inflation regime that triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
